checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: One finished 16:9 image contains both photos side by side
must.why: 640x384 is about 5:3, not exactly 16:9, but it reads as a landscape side-by-side. Slightly off ratio.

must.item: Brown kitchen left, white kitchen right

must.why: Both labels are clear white text on black bars.

must.item: Both complete photos visible without stretching or content changes
must.why: Photos are cropped and squeezed, and the AI redrew them. The After photo has a changed ceiling, a different floor and a different counter shape. The Before photo has lost the top and the right edge.

faults.what: Both photos are cropped and squashed into the lower frame, so parts of the originals are lost, including the right side of Before and the ceiling.
The AI regenerated the photo contents. The After kitchen has a different ceiling, a different floor and a different counter, and the Before photo has altered details.
The aspect ratio is about 5:3, not true 16:9.
The black label bars take up a lot of space and compress the photos.

summary: The output has the correct order and clean Before/After labels, but the photos were regenerated and cropped rather than kept as they were, and the ratio is not true 16:9.
